name: baijiahao-mcp
description: Baijiahao (social): me, read_comments, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

platform_mcp_baijiahao_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIJIAHAO_APP_ID
platform_mcp_baijiahao_app_id.description: 作者帐号ID (app_id) shown when you enable 开发者 service in the 百家号 creator console (开通开发者服务，获取app_token及app_id).

platform_mcp_baijiahao_app_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIJIAHAO_APP_TOKEN
platform_mcp_baijiahao_app_token.description: 授权密钥 (app_token) from the same 开发者 settings; sent in the request body of every call. Reset it at once if it leaks.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No self-profile call is documented, so the credentials are verified with query/articleListall (page_size 1): errno 0 answers {page, items{article_id: {article_id, nid, title, type, status, collection, article_url, updated_at}}}; errno 60001001 means 授权校验失败.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: query/articleCommentList (article_id, page_no, page_size ≤ 20): comments on one article (post_id = the article_id from the 百家号 console or article list), each {reply_id, thread_id, uname, avatar, content, create_time (epoch s), like_count, reply_count, favor, is_fans, reply_to_uname?}; data.page.has_next tells whether another page exists. Replies to one comment are at query/articleCommentReplyList (https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/getCommentResponse).

tools.name: delete
tools.description: article/withdraw (撤回内容) takes the published article's NID as article_id: the article stops being shown ('撤回后的文章将不再展示'); personalised-recommended articles cannot be withdrawn. Permanent deletion (article/delete, https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/delete) only applies to drafts of 图文/横版视频 and to published 小视频, so it is not what this verb maps to.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: query/articleStatistics (article_id): cumulative recommend_count, view_count (阅读/播放量), comment_count, share_count, collect_count and likes_count since publication (-1 = 获取失败); no per-day series. The runtime cannot compose a nested metrics object or echo the post_id argument, so counts are top-level fields (all of data stays in raw).
